Definition: from G3844 and G251; beside the salt (sea), i.e. maritime:--sea coast.
BiblicalUsage: Paralios means beside the sea, of the seacoast. Jesus comes down with His disciples and stands in the plain, with a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who come to hear Him and be healed.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the sea coast crowd shows how far His fame reaches: from Jerusalem to the shores of Tyre and Sidon, they come to hear and to be healed.
